_comment: All damage configs validated via check_fragment_adjacency.py --remove_set. piece_0=base, piece_1/3/4/5/8/11=body, piece_2/6/7/9/10=neck (piece_2 is the mouth/drinking opening, no separate cap on this bottle type). body_severe uses piece_0 (base) as a different damage spot from body_simple's piece_5, following the established pattern for regions without a clean size progression.
